correctness.rationale: The exact 4-edge chordal representation is geometrically normalized; any proper subset of the cycle is a forest, giving genuine triplewise independence. Classical Funk--Hecke with the derived Legendre-log integral yields lambda_l=-1/[2l(l+1)] with multiplicity 2l+1. The Hilbert--Schmidt log-kernel T has trace-class T^4, and the four-cycle expectation is Tr(T^4). Exact partial fractions evaluate this sum as 5/16-zeta(3)/4. Multinomial counting then gives E[log|Z|^4]=12-6zeta(3). Standalone symbolic, high precision and Monte Carlo checks succeeded, but only analytical steps prove all parameter-free equalities.
